_comment: Copy to users/<you>/polaris.json and fill in. The top level is your default access: ALCF's facility multi-user endpoint, which needs nothing installed. `profiles` names alternatives for the same machine, picked by "profile" in campaign.json or PROFILE=<name>; a profile overrides only the keys it names.

own._comment: Your own Globus Compute endpoint instead (systems/endpoints/polaris_pbs).
